species.real: The bombardier beetle mixes two chemicals in a chamber in its abdomen and fires out a popping spray at around boiling point.
species.name: Squibbet

dex.text: Hides under damp logs and squirts a hot, sour spray at anything that picks it up. Naturalists have been learning this lesson the hard way since the 1820s.
dex.fact: As a student, Charles Darwin held a rare beetle in each hand, found a third and put one in his mouth to free a hand; it squirted something burning and he lost all three.

species.real: Darwin's first appearance in print was as a beetle collector: a rare beetle he caught as a Cambridge student was recorded in a book on British insects as 'captured by C. Darwin'.
species.name: Darwing

dex.text: No two broods look quite alike, and whichever suits the weather does best. Its wing cases crackle with static in a storm. It seems very pleased with itself about all this.
dex.fact: Charles Darwin, born in Shrewsbury in 1809, explained evolution by natural selection in On the Origin of Species, published in 1859.
